answer: Hardware attestation stops sybil farms. A newcomer proves its secure enclave signed the challenge, and the ledger binds that enclave to one key; two auditors check it in seven days, and a reused enclave is rejected while a forged one bans it. One honest agent holds one device; a thousand fakes need a thousand devices at fifty dollars each, so the farm pays fifty thousand, while an ocean, an opal chip, and a nadir check mark every real device.
